info.name: Mouza Map Pro (MMP) - API Collection
info.description: Complete and comprehensive Postman collection for Mouza Map Pro (MMP) backend APIs, including Auth, Services catalog, Districts & Upazilas, Surveyor directory, Surveyor profile, and standalone Surveyor services.

item.name: 01. Authentication & Profile
item.description: User registration, OTP email verification, login, JWT token refresh, and user profile management.

request.description: Register a new user account. Sends a 6-digit OTP code to the provided email address for verification.
Verify user email address using the 6-digit OTP received via email. Returns access and refresh tokens upon success.
Resends a new 6-digit OTP to the registered unverified email address.
Login with email and password. Returns user object, accessToken and refreshToken, and sets auth cookies.
Generates a new accessToken using the refreshToken from body or cookies.
Get current logged-in user profile, roles, primary location, and associated surveyor profile (if any).
Update personal information and primary location of current logged-in user. All fields are optional.
Send a 6-digit password reset OTP to the user's email address.
Resends a new 6-digit password reset OTP to the user's email.
Verify OTP and reset account password with new password.
Change password for logged-in user. For users without password (Google OAuth), oldPassword is optional.
Logs out current user and clears authentication cookies.

item.name: 02. Services (Catalog)
item.description: Master catalog of land survey services offered on Mouza Map Pro (e.g. Land Measurement, Mouza Map Studio, Boundary Determination).

request.description: Public endpoint to retrieve the list of all available services.
Public endpoint to retrieve single service details by its unique slug.
Admin only endpoint to add a new service to the catalog.
Admin only endpoint to update an existing service by its slug.
Admin only endpoint to remove a service from the catalog.

item.name: 03. Districts & Upazilas
item.description: Location hierarchy catalog containing districts and their nested upazilas across Bangladesh.

request.description: Public catalog returning all districts with their label, slug value, and list of upazila names.
Admin only endpoint to add a new district.
Admin only endpoint to update district name or slug.
Admin only endpoint to delete a district.
Admin only endpoint to add an upazila under a district.
Admin only endpoint to update an upazila.
Admin only endpoint to delete an upazila.

item.name: 04. Surveyor Directory & Profiles
item.description: Public surveyor listing, detailed public profiles, application as a surveyor, self-profile updates, and admin verification.

item.name: Get All Verified Surveyors (Public with Filters & Pagination)

query.description: Search by surveyor name, headline, bio, location or service name
Filter by minimum rating (e.g. 4 for 4+ stars)
Sort order: rating_desc | experience_desc | newest | oldest

request.description: Public listing endpoint returning verified surveyors with pagination meta (page, limit, total, totalPages) and full nested service & area data.
Public endpoint to retrieve complete public profile of a surveyor including user information, services with starting prices, service areas, and approved reviews.
Retrieve logged-in surveyor's own profile data (Surveyor role required).
Submit an application to register as a professional surveyor. Creates profile in PENDING verification status.
Update logged-in surveyor profile fields (headline, bio, experienceYears, serviceAreas, services). All fields are optional.

variable.description: User ID of the applicant surveyor

request.description: Admin only endpoint to approve or reject a surveyor's application. When approved, user role is upgraded to SURVEYOR.

item.name: 05. Surveyor Standalone Services
item.description: Endpoints for a surveyor to manage their individual services and starting prices outside the full profile update.

request.description: Get all services and custom starting prices configured by the logged-in surveyor.
Add a new service to the logged-in surveyor's profile.
Update the starting price of a service already assigned to the surveyor's profile.
Delete/remove an assigned service from the surveyor's profile.

item.name: 06. Land Measurement & Saved Calculations
item.description: Endpoints to manage saved land measurement calculations, polygon plot coordinates, and measurement activity statistics.

query.description: Optional search query by calculation name or map name
Sort order: newest | oldest | name_asc | name_desc

request.description: Retrieve a paginated list of the logged-in user's saved calculations with search and sort support.
Save a new land measurement calculation and its polygon plots to the user's account.
Retrieve full details and plot points of a single saved calculation.
Update the name, scale, map reference, or plot geometry of an existing calculation.
Permanently delete a saved calculation and its associated plot records.
Get total plots completed, calculations count, and last measurement activity timestamp for the logged-in user.
Admin only endpoint to view measurement activity statistics across all users.

item.name: 07. User Management (Admin)
item.description: Admin endpoints to list users, search, filter by role/status, inspect user details, update status, change roles, and delete accounts.

query.description: Search by name, email, or phone
Filter by role: USER | SURVEYOR | ADMIN
Sort order: newest | oldest | name_asc | name_desc

request.description: Retrieve paginated list of users with search, role, status filters, and plot measurement statistics.
Create a new administrator account directly with role ADMIN (Admin only).
Retrieve full profile, measurement stats, and calculation count for a single user.
Update user account status between ACTIVE and BLOCKED.
Change user role between USER, SURVEYOR, and ADMIN.
Permanently delete a user account and associated data.

item.name: 08. Service Management (Admin & Public)
item.description: Land surveying service categories catalog, descriptions, creation, updates, and deletion.

query.description: Search by name, slug, or description

request.description: Retrieve all service categories with search and pagination support.
Get detailed service info including surveyor count.
Create a new surveying service catalog item (Admin only).
Update service name, slug, or description (Admin only).
Delete a service category (Admin only).

item.name: 07. Surveyor Verification Requests
item.description: Admin APIs for reviewing, approving, and rejecting surveyor verification (KYC) applications.

query.description: Filter by status: ALL | PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED

request.description: Retrieve paginated list of surveyor verification requests with optional status filter and search term (Admin only).

variable.description: Surveyor Profile ID or User ID

request.description: Get detailed application information for a specific surveyor verification request (Admin only).
Approve or reject a surveyor's verification application. Approving will automatically grant SURVEYOR platform role (Admin only).

item.name: 08. Reviews Management
item.description: Public review submissions and Admin review moderation endpoints.

request.description: Submit a customer review for a surveyor. The review will be set to PENDING status until approved by an admin.

query.description: Filter by status: ALL | PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED

request.description: Retrieve paginated list of reviews with optional search and status filtering (Admin only).
Approve or reject a review. Approving will automatically update the surveyor's public rating and review count (Admin only).
Permanently delete a review and recalculate surveyor's rating (Admin only).
Retrieve all subscription pricing plans with automatic seed if database is empty.

request.description: Retrieve detailed plan information by ID or slug code.

request.description: Create a new subscription pricing plan (Admin only).
Update an existing subscription plan (Admin only).
Toggle active/inactive status for a plan (Admin only).
Delete a subscription plan (Admin only. Fails if active subscriptions exist).

item.name: 10. Subscribers Management
item.description: Admin endpoints to monitor subscribers, manage memberships, extend periods, and revoke subscriptions.

request.description: Retrieve paginated list of subscribers with user details, active plan, and validity (Admin only).
Get detailed subscriber and payment information (Admin only).
Manually grant a subscription to a user (Admin only).
Extend subscription validity by a specified number of days (Admin only).
Cancel active subscription and revert user to Free status (Admin only).

item.name: 11. Broadcast Notifications
item.description: Endpoints for system-wide announcements, promotional campaign banners, and maintenance alerts.

request.description: Get currently active announcements for banner/notification feed.
Retrieve paginated announcements for Admin management.

request.description: Create and publish a new broadcast notification.
Edit an existing announcement (Admin only).
Quickly toggle active/inactive state of an announcement.
Permanently delete an announcement (Admin only).

item.name: 12. Admin Dashboard Overview
item.description: Endpoints for real-time aggregated metrics, platform performance, and analytics charts.

request.description: Retrieve comprehensive aggregated metrics, monthly growth trends, top district distribution, and recent activity feed.
